sources.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the original warm living-room FPV camera scene.
Primary request: preserve this exact warm room and fix the one mismatched wooden furniture leg. The conspicuously straight vertical square post at about 38% of the image width (just left of the sofa, extending from the top frame to the floor) does not match the other three legs of the same foreground wooden furniture. Correct that leg so it has the same timber, dark warm wood finish, subtly tapered square cross section, thickness and outward splay as the other three legs, taking perspective into account. Its top must attach plausibly to the same furniture frame above; its foot must contact the floor naturally with a matching contact shadow. The furniture should read as one coherent real four-legged object, not an assortment of unrelated posts. Do not add extra legs or stray horizontal supports.
Preserve: the exact floor-height FPV camera position and wide framing, the warm amber lamp at the right, daylight and curtains at the left, sofa with blue cushions and draped blanket, plants, sideboard, framed art, existing wood floor color and reflections. Preserve the inviting warmth and original composition. Keep all other existing furniture and the scene unchanged as closely as possible.
Scope: change the single odd leg and only the small surrounding area needed for the physically correct geometry and its shadow. Do not redesign the room, move the sofa, remove furniture, change the lighting, change the color grade, or replace the furniture style.
Output: standalone full-bleed 16:9 camera view, same composition and image orientation as input. No HUD, no text, no crosshair, no border, no visible car, no watermark. Photographic material and coherent joinery, not a 3D render.

sources.title: Driver HUD over illustrative scene
sources.method: Rendered by mpv/libass using ASS output from the unchanged HUD drawing functions in drive.mjs over the new generated scene. Static demonstration state: 35% throttle, -10% steering, trim 0, REC 00:27, UDP 25 FPS. Courier New keeps the earlier screenshot typography. The scene is scaled/cropped proportionally to 1280x720; the same HUD frame feeds the app window, Steam Deck display and later HUD image. No driver session or car connection was started. This is not live car footage.
